Game Overview

In Brickball, the core idea is straightforward: relive classic arcade excitement with Brickball. Maneuver your paddle with precision, aiming to shatter endless brick patterns while unlocking power-ups. Enjoy the thrill of bouncing a ball in a beautifully retro environment. It's simple yet captivating, promising endless hours of challenging fun.
